lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots organized into approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge feature in the upper third of the flank, defined by a high-contrast luminance transition from superior light to inferior shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) positioned beneath the pectoral fin and trailing along the ventral-lateral line.
